text:
Elena (People Ops): Thanks all for a great all-hands. Quick follow-up thread for hiring/org questions — I'll try to answer as many as I can. Ask here and we'll keep it short.
Mason (VP Eng): Can you confirm the number of new infra/platform hires in the plan? I heard a couple different numbers.
Priya (Head of Recruiting): Confirming: hiring slate currently lists 18 roles for Eng Platform/Runtime combined (12 IC, 4 TPM, 2 EM). We're actively sourcing for the 12 ICs now.
Riley (IC): For the TPMs, are those product TPM or platform TPM? Any expectation about onsite requirement?
Priya (Head of Recruiting): Platform TPMs (systems + infra orchestration). Most roles are hybrid-first — candidates in SF/SEA/NY preferred; relocation package available for senior hires.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Will any of the Platform headcount be backfills vs net new? Curious how that impacts team velocity.
Mason (VP Eng): Good Q — of those 18, 10 are net-new capacity; 8 are backfills/realignments from recent team changes. Net increase in Eng headcount for FY27 is +55.
Sam (FP&A): To add numbers: company headcount now ~150; FY27 target is ~205 by EOY (so +55 net). Budget ties those hires to revenue milestones and ramp forecasts — we'll prioritize customer-facing infra (Dedicated/Private) and core runtime.
Riley (IC): Any hiring freeze we should know about or is this full steam ahead?
Elena (People Ops): Not a freeze — it's a prioritized ramp. We will hire selectively: critical roles and those that unlock revenue/SLAs first. That means some non-critical reqs will be deferred.
Priya (Head of Recruiting): Operationally: expect 2-week shortlist -> 3 interview loops -> offer cadence. We're piloting a faster track for senior latency/hardware experts (1-week loop).
Jordan (Eng Manager): For managers: if we want to request a transfer or split a headcount, who do we talk to?
Elena (People Ops): Talk to your manager + cc me/People Ops. We'll route internal candidates first and maintain a shared spreadsheet (internal mobility) — also will post the updated org chart.
Riley (IC): About leveling and compensation: will there be adjustments for folks shifting into newly defined roles under the reorg?
Sam (FP&A): Compensation adjustments for level changes will be handled case-by-case. We have a small budget for promotions/level adjustments tied to role scope changes. Please submit calibration requests by next Thursday.
Priya (Head of Recruiting): Also note interview scorecards have new emphasis on operational experience for runtime roles. If you're interviewing, expect one live debugging/system design exercise.
Elena (People Ops): On timelines — we're aiming to post an updated hiring slate + annotated org chart by EOD Monday. We'll also run a short follow-up sync for managers mid-week.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Great — will managers get a heads-up doc for which reqs are prioritized?
Priya (Head of Recruiting): Yes, managers will get the prioritized slate and hiring templates today. We're also sharing a short FAQ for internal candidates (transfer process, relocation, leveling).
Riley (IC): Appreciate the clarity. One last ask — can we get transparency on blackout dates for rotations / hiring pauses around major launches?
Mason (VP Eng): We'll avoid major pauses during top-priority launches, but hiring interviews may be deprioritized during critical two-week sprints. We'll share a calendar of recruitment blackout windows for Q2.
